law: tech#21 (P2 queue R1832). v2 = phrase-level expansion closing the v1-excluded single-char families (noise char anchored inside a verbatim phrase = collision-free). Extends v1 via the loader merge; v1 stays untouched as its own file. S2 asr-check QC channel, OPT-IN ONLY (--noise-dict). NEVER for real-voice transcripts (persona rule: real voice first - corrupting a real-voice transcript with a TTS-domain dictionary is forbidden).
direction: noise -> true : noise = what the ASR channel wrote, true = the term the TTS track actually says. src=verbatim means the noise string is quoted verbatim from an archived ASR artifact; src=composed means the noise side is derived by applying a RECORDED char/word substitution (station-reviews asr-check row) to a verbatim beats phrase - composed entries are marked per entry and never fire on text the piece did not mishear, because they only match the misheard phrase itself.
evidence: v1 rows (BS-002 R174 / BS-003 R180 / BS-004 R187 / BS-013 R1683 / BS-014 R1686 / BS-015 R1690 / BS-016 R1693) + verbatim archived ASR artifacts: data/storylines/audio/sc001-01-v2-tmp/asr-check.srt (cue17-18 一半个 / cue26 归居民+归荡者 verbatim) + SC-001 chapter rows R223/R225/R227/R229/R231/R272
